description: Two server replicas sharing one Postgres store: a request created on instance A is visible and inspectable on instance B through B's store-backed read path. This is the end-to-end, two-process counterpart to the Go-side TestActiveActive_CrossInstanceVisibility proof. It exercises two real toolplane-server processes against one Postgres store, proving the session and request read-through paths work across replicas. Requires TOOLPLANE_CONFORMANCE_MULTI_INSTANCE=1 plus TOOLPLANE_DATABASE_URL so the conformance bootstrap boots a second server replica.
